messages:
marie: Heads-up: PR 3622 preview failed CI. linkcheck + markdown-lint + vale. Need a quick pair to triage so we can merge before the docs release window.
ash: on it — can you paste the failing excerpt/error lines?
marie: linkcheck: "https://internal.setup.local/guide" -> 404 (internal-only). markdown-lint: MD013 line length 1 occurrence. vale: WARN for weasel words ("quite", "very") and passive voice. also spellcheck flagged "teh" in the intro.
docs-ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #3622 1 linkcheck: 1 error, markdown-lint: 1 error, vale: 2 warnings, spellcheck: 1 warning. Full log: https://ci.redwood/preview/3622
jordan: for internal URLs we usually point to the public mirror under docs.redwood.ai or add a short note that the internal link is only for on-prem installs and keep a public fallback. simplest fix: swap to https://docs.redwood.ai/setup-quickstart for now.
marie: ok i'll replace the link. on the MD013, it's the long example paragraph in the migration guide — i can break into two lines and remove the "very" and "quite".
ajordan: also add a language tag to the code fence (```bash) — untagged fences sometimes break the preview highlighter which looks like a render bug.
ash: i'll make a tiny commit to correct the spelling, split the sentence, and swap the URL. will also run vale locally to confirm.
marie: i pushed commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3622/files changed the paragraph, fixed "teh" -> "the", replaced link, tagged the snippet with ```bash and shortened lines.
docs-ci-bot: Re-run triggered for PR #3622. Results: linkcheck: PASS, markdown-lint: PASS, vale: WARN (1 suggestion: replace "utilise" -> "use"), spellcheck: PASS. Preview deploy:  SUCCESS 
marie: nice. @jordan can you quick-approve? we want this merged before the 3pm PT docs cut.
jordan: LGTM, approving now. please merge before 15:00 PT. :shipit:
marie: merged and backfilled the changelog entry. thanks y'all! :pray:
